title: NIE: your assignment filing card
intro: Use this when you need a NIE assigned because you have an economic, professional or social connection with Spain. A NIE is an identification number; it is not, by itself, permission to live or work in Spain.
status: National procedure · appointment handling can vary by province

items.label: Procedure
items.text: Asignación de Número de Identidad de Extranjero (NIE) a instancia de interesado — application form EX-15.

items.label: Where to go
items.text: In Spain, apply through the Dirección General de la Policía, an Oficina de Extranjería or a Police station handling the procedure. If you are outside Spain, the official procedure allows the request through a Spanish consular office abroad.

items.label: What to select
items.text: Look for NIE assignment / Asignación de NIE in the appointment flow offered for your province. Do not choose EU registration or a TIE/fingerprinting appointment instead; the exact appointment label can vary by office.

items.label: Forms and fee
items.text: Prepare EX-15 and the proof of payment for Modelo 790, código 012 that corresponds to NIE assignment. Check the current official fee before paying rather than relying on an old amount.

items.label: Bring
bullets: Valid passport or identity document accepted for your case
Proof of payment of Modelo 790 código 012
Documents showing the economic, professional or social reason for requesting the NIE
Appointment confirmation and any copies requested by the office handling your application
Representation or authorization documents if someone is legally acting for you

items.label: What happens after
items.text: If the request is accepted, you receive the assigned NIE for your dealings in Spain. The number does not replace the residence registration, visa or residence authorization that may separately apply to your stay.
